knowledge.textEn: With a anchors per position, proposals number HWa before filtering, not final detections.

stages.title: Faster R-CNN：張量、座標與來源介面
stages.titleEn: Faster R-CNN: tensors, coordinates and evidence
stages.description: Faster R-CNN 的區域提案網路與偵測器共享卷積特徵。；為單個特徵中心列9組尺度比例，再標影像座標、邊界裁切及物件性分數。
stages.descriptionEn: Faster R-CNN shares convolutional features between proposal and detection networks.; Enumerate nine scale-ratio pairs at one feature center and annotate image coordinates, clipping and objectness.
